channel.description: Recent content in AI on ExitCode0

item.title: How to Give Claude Code a Real Browser: Headful Chromium in Docker with Playwright MCP
item.description: Run a headful Chromium in Docker on your dev VM so Claude Code can browse, shop and screenshot sites with no laptop on, and watch it over VNC from a phone.

item.title: How I Turned My Laptop Into a Dumb Terminal With a Tailscale Dev VM, T3 Code, and Claude Code
item.description: A persistent dev VM over Tailscale running T3 Code and Claude Code turns any laptop into a thin client, and why I'm stripping Windows down instead of upgrading.

item.title: Building a Dependency Audit Extension for Pi Agent - and What Mini Shai Hulud Taught Me About npm Supply Chains
item.description: A TypeScript extension for Pi Agent that audits installed npm packages against the advisory database at startup. How it works and where it falls short.

item.title: Understanding Pi Agent's Extension Model: Context Files, Skills, and TypeScript Extensions
item.description: Pi Agent has four customisation layers: context files, prompt templates, skills and TypeScript extensions. What each does and when to reach for it.

item.title: Give Claude Code Eyes Inside Your WSL2 Docker Containers
item.description: Stop pasting Docker Compose logs into Claude Code. Give it SSH access into WSL2 so it reads container logs directly, the same trick used with a Kali VM.

item.title: Running Ollama in a Proxmox LXC with NVIDIA GPU Passthrough
item.description: Set up Ollama in a Proxmox LXC with NVIDIA GPU passthrough, Tailscale access and Open WebUI. Run local LLMs with GPU acceleration on your own hardware.

item.title: Testing Llama3.1 (8B) With LM Studio
item.description: Taking a look at the the latest open source llama 3.1 model after its July 2024 release. Testing its performance and accuracy with GPT4ALL.

item.title: Testing Llama3 With LM Studio
item.description: Taking a look at the the latest open source llama 3 model after its April 2024 release. Testing its performance and accuracy with LM Studio.

item.title: Generating Artwork With Local Stable Diffusion on an RTX GPU: What Works and What Doesn't
item.description: A look at the state of artwork generation with stable-diffusion in April 2024. Investigating if (local) stable-diffusion can reliably produce enjoyable artwork.
